slots_and_copies.name: global_config
slots_and_copies.selection_rule: Single global block: header 0x20 at 0x780 + data 0x10 at 0x7A0. Loaded at boot by 0x080192d8; created by 0x08019c1c only if global load fails and all slots invalid; saved by 0x08019c80 (caller absent from corpus). No backup copy.

checksums.name: slot_payload_checksum
checksums.formula_detail: h=0xAA55A5A5; for each byte b in RAM payload order: h=ROL32(h,1)+b (mod 2^32). Implemented in FUN_0806f1c0 (h=_DAT_0806f1dc seed, recovered as 0xAA55A5A5 by inverting all 8 stored regions, then verified forward). Stored as u32_le in RAM header at +0x0C; in .sav bytes it appears at slot file +0x08 due to the 8-byte-block reversal transform (file[block*8+i]=ram[block*8+7-i]), which must be undone before computing.

checksums.name: global_data_checksum
checksums.formula_detail: Same FUN_0806f1c0 ROL1-add hash, seed 0xAA55A5A5, over the 16-byte RAM global data block. Stored as u32_le in RAM global header at +0x0C; appears at file 0x788 due to the 8-byte-block reversal transform.

io_driver_functions.notes: DMA3 transfer primitive; writes DMA src/dst/count (count|0x80000000) via pointer-indirect registers (DMA3 block 0x040000D4), waits on busy bit. Callers pass EEPROM window 0x0D000000 as one endpoint. Roles read+write (direction depends on src/dst order).

EEPROM read one 64-bit block: command 1,1 + address (bits at typeblock+8) MSB-first via DMA to/from 0x0D000000, reassembles 4x u16 backwards from dst+6. 0x08072b44 caller is textual (line 8650), absent from callgraph.json.
EEPROM write one 64-bit block: command 1,0 + address + 64 data bits MSB-first + trailing 0, DMA out (len bits+0x43), polls EEPROM bit0 with timer timeout 0x88.
Verify-read: reads block via 0x0807a528, compares 4x u16, returns 0x8000 on mismatch else 0.
Write gate: skips physical write when typeblock size field ==0x200 (512); else calls 0x0807a5ec. Typeblock layout unresolved.
Write one block with verify, up to 3 retries (write via 0x0807a7e4, verify via 0x0807a74c). Caller edge is textual (line 8698); callgraph.json shows no callers.
Byte-range EEPROM read (offset,dst,len,*err): block=(offset>>3)+i via 0x0807a528, bus lock 0x08072924/0x0806ae84(1) and unlock 0x08072930/0x0806ae84(0).
Byte-range EEPROM write (offset,src,len,*err): per-8-byte via 0x0807a81c, same lock pairing.
Public read gate: returns -1 if ready flag is 0 else forwards 4 args to 0x08072b44. Printed prototype shows 1 arg due to unrecovered jumptable.
Public write gate: returns -1 if ready flag is 0 else forwards 4 args to 0x08072bf0.
EEPROM type select (4 / 0x40 / other). Boot selects 0x40 via 0x08072b30 <- 0x08072abc <- 0x080002f4. Role is device-configure, closest schema value serialize.
ROL32(h,1)+byte hash, seed 0xAA55A5A5 (literal _DAT_0806f1dc, recovered from .sav). Covers slot payload 0x260 or global data 0x10.
Pack game struct -> 608B payload buffer at scrambled offsets + 58B copy game+0x8C..+0xC5 -> payload+0x38..+0x71.
Unpack payload -> game struct. NO body in corpus (call site only); called after checksum verifies.
Save slot: counter update, pack, header+0x10=1, header+0x0C=checksum(payload,0x260), writes header 0x20 + payload 0x260 at slot*0x280. In-game trigger caller absent from corpus.
Load slot full: reads header+payload, verifies header+0x0C vs checksum, calls unpack 0x08019a50 on match.
Probe slot: header read, counter <0x65 fast path, else full load via 0x08019754.
Create blank slot: defaults 0x080194e0 + pack + save, then rewrite with counter=0, flag=0. Called x6 at boot (lines 82-94).
New-game game-struct defaults (250/10/200/7/120/5 etc.) + zeroes 608B buffer via memset 0x0807c954.
Load global: reads 0x780/0x7A0, verifies checksum, clamps data fields ([0,5],[0,2],[0,0x100],[0,0x100]).
Create default global data (u16+0=unresolved const, +2=1, u32+4=0xC0, +8=0x100), checksum to header+0x0C, writes 0x780/0x7A0.
Save global: refreshes data+4/+8 from live globals, recomputes checksum, writes 0x780/0x7A0. NO caller in corpus.
Probe all 3 slots at boot, records status -1/0/1 at struct+0xDC/+0xFC/+0x11C; uses absent-bodied string compare 0x0806e918.

open_questions: Unpacker FUN 0x08019a50 has no body in the 298-function corpus: payload->game assignments are inferred only as inverse of pack 0x08019958.
String compare 0x0806e918 and its constant (uRam08019894 family) absent: slot header byte0 label semantics and boot status 0-vs-1 rule incomplete.
In-game slot-save trigger calling 0x0801969c during play absent (only blank-slot creator 0x08019b5c traced); global-save 0x08019c80 has no caller in corpus.
All absolute RAM mirror addresses unrecoverable: decompilation exports only _DAT_08019xxxx placeholders without literal-pool values. Fields mapped by buffer-relative offset.
EEPROM type-block numeric fields (*(u16*)(block+4) capacity, *(u8*)(block+8) address bits, size gate 0x200 in 0x0807a7e4) unresolved; capacity 1024 blocks inferred from 8192-byte image.
Exact counter increment arithmetic in 0x0801969c (unresolved _DAT_080196c8 string buffer, ':'/0x3A overflow path) not quotable beyond incremented/reset semantics.
Gameplay semantics (names) of all payload fields and global settings fields unknown: both samples contain only default/blank state, no non-default slot ever observed.
Global data +0x00 flush history (cap-00 -1 -> cap-01 0 via load-clamp then 0x08019c80) is a hypothesis: 0x08019c80 writes only +4/+8 in its traced body.
Lock helpers 0x08072ad0/0x08072adc/0x08072924/0x08072930/0x0806ae84 inner semantics (interrupt vs DMA mutex) unrecovered; roles assigned by bracketing position only.
